project_type: Python async Telegram bot with distributed worker system for IVA card scanning
build_system: None (pure Python, requirements.txt for pip dependencies)
test_framework: No test framework (operational tool, not library). Verification is structural: imports resolve, syntax is valid.
build_command: python -m py_compile run.py && python -c "import ast; import pathlib; [ast.parse(f.read_text()) for f in pathlib.Path('.').rglob('*.py')]"
test_command: python -c "import ast; import pathlib; [ast.parse(f.read_text()) for f in pathlib.Path('.').rglob('*.py')]"
verification_instructions: 1. All .py files parse without SyntaxError. 2. run.py can be imported (no missing module references within the project). 3. requirements.txt lists all external deps.
setup_instructions: On production server: pip install -r requirements.txt && cp .env.example .env && nano .env && python run.py
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - cannot pip install, cannot reach PyPI or any external URL. Validation limited to AST parsing and import-chain verification within the project. No Docker daemon available.
contribution_requirements: Complete rewrite. Delete ALL old C#/Docker files. Replace with clean Python project at repo root.
key_patterns: Inspired by Makiioo reference: worker.py (master-side orchestration with SSH tunnels + health checks), worker_api.py (FastAPI on loopback with Bearer auth), worker_transfer.py (SSH provisioning with Docker). Telegram bot uses Telethon. Panel separators use '-------------------------------'. All bot messages in Persian. Config from .env via python-dotenv. SQLite for persistence.
directory_structure: Target structure (flat in repo root): core/ (crypto, auth, scanner, constants), bot/ (app.py, panels/, utils.py), worker/ (server.py, tasks.py, deploy.py), db.py, config.py, run.py, requirements.txt, .env.example
